Layer 02 · Bus systems

Designed around the complete bus air system.

RILKE's bus-focused architecture connects compression, drying, storage, drain, kneeling, leveling and suspension functions instead of treating each component in isolation.

Transit & coach

Kneeling, leveling & suspension control

Application-specific pneumatic control for access, ride height and vehicle stability, supported by valves, dryers, compressors and related hardware.

Integrated architecture

From valve to manifold to system

Where integration creates value, RILKE can combine multiple functions into a compact manifold or assembly engineered for the OEM application.

Layer 03 · Engineering

Product supply when possible. Engineering when necessary.

RILKE combines catalog supply with Technoforme's prototyping and manufacturing capability to solve obsolete, unavailable and application-specific component problems.

01

Application Engineering

Pressure, media, voltage, duty cycle, environment, flow and interface requirements translated into the correct component architecture.

02

Reverse Engineering

Dimensional reconstruction, material review, sealing analysis, 3D CAD and replacement development for unavailable or obsolete parts.

03

OEM Development

Custom valves, manifolds and assemblies developed from prototype through controlled production.

Layer 05 · Product intelligence

Every component can carry its identity.

RILKE components are being developed around traceability: consistent product marking, laser-engraved QR identification and digital access to part information, support and replacement history.

Laser-engraved ID

Permanent product identification on valves, manifolds and assemblies.

QR traceability

Fast access to the correct part family, technical data and replacement information.

Engineering records

Configuration and application data can follow the product throughout its service life.

OEM support

A clearer path from installed component to service, replacement or redesign.
